scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa
description:
The scheme titled "Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa" was launched by the Government of Goa on April 1, 2021. 

This initiative aims to enhance the livelihood of fishermen in Goa by providing financial support for the purchase or construction of new fishing vessels. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to promote sustainable fishing practices and improve the economic conditions of local fishermen. 

The government has set a measurable target of supporting at least 500 fishermen annually under this scheme. 

The assistance provided under this scheme is specifically directed towards the purchase or construction of fishing crafts that are less than 26 feet in length. 

Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to 50 percent of the total cost of the fishing craft. 

The maximum financial assistance amount is capped at ₹2 lakh per beneficiary. 

This financial support is intended to cover both the purchase of ready-made fishing crafts as well as the costs associated with constructing new vessels. 

The scheme is particularly focused on promoting the use of eco-friendly fishing practices. 

To be eligible for this scheme, applicants must be registered fishermen in Goa. 

Applicants must possess a valid fishing license issued by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for eligibility. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need of financial support. 

Educational qualifications are not a prerequisite for applying for this scheme. 

The application process involves several specific steps. 

Firstly, interested applicants must obtain the application form from the Directorate of Fisheries or download it from the official website. 

The application form requires details such as the applicant's name, address, fishing license number, and income details. 

Applicants must also provide a detailed project report outlining the proposed use of the financial assistance. 

Along with the application form, applicants need to submit a copy of their fishing license. 

A copy of the Aadhaar card or any other government-issued identity proof is also required. 

Additionally, proof of income such as an income certificate or a recent income tax return must be submitted. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the Directorate of Fisheries. 

The Directorate will then review the applications and verify the provided information. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance will be disbursed to the beneficiaries. 

The disbursement is typically made in a single installment after the approval of the application. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

The Directorate of Fisheries is the implementing authority for this scheme. 

The contact details for the Directorate of Fisheries are as follows: Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, Dayanand Bandodkar Road, Panaji, Goa - 403001. 

The contact number for inquiries is +91 832 222 3670. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Goa to support the fishing community and promote sustainable fishing practices. 

The fishing industry in Goa is a significant contributor to the state's economy, providing livelihoods to thousands of families. 

The government recognizes the importance of modernizing the fishing fleet to enhance productivity and safety. 

This scheme is aligned with the National Fisheries Policy, which aims to promote sustainable fishing and improve the socio-economic conditions of fishermen across India. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is expected to lead to an increase in fish production in the inland waters of Goa. 

This, in turn, will contribute to food security and the overall economic development of the state. 

The government also aims to create awareness among fishermen about sustainable fishing practices through this initiative. 

The scheme encourages the use of modern fishing techniques and equipment to improve catch efficiency. 

Fishermen are also encouraged to participate in training programs organized by the Directorate of Fisheries. 

These training programs focus on sustainable fishing methods and the responsible use of aquatic resources. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the livelihoods of fishermen by reducing their operational costs. 

By providing financial assistance for new fishing crafts, the government aims to reduce the dependency on older, less efficient vessels. 

The initiative is also expected to promote safety at sea by encouraging the use of modern fishing crafts that meet safety standards. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹10 crore for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2021-2022. 

This budget is expected to support the construction and purchase of approximately 500 fishing crafts. 

The scheme is a significant step towards empowering the fishing community in Goa. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the living standards of fishermen and ensuring sustainable fishing practices. 

The financial assistance is expected to stimulate local economies by increasing the purchasing power of fishermen. 

As fishermen acquire new crafts, it is anticipated that there will be an increase in employment opportunities within the fishing industry. 

The scheme is also expected to attract younger individuals to the fishing profession by providing them with the necessary resources. 

The government is committed to monitoring the progress of the scheme and making necessary adjustments based on feedback from beneficiaries. 

Overall, the "Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa" scheme is a comprehensive initiative aimed at transforming the fishing sector in Goa. 

It seeks to empower local fishermen by providing them with the tools they need to succeed in a competitive industry. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to ensure that the fishing community thrives while also promoting sustainable practices that protect the environment.
